I'm particularly interested in the mid-tier option because it means we would have {{3}} when things get crowded, plus we'd actually get to attend those hands-on workshops we keep talking about.

It's a chance to stop being mere spectators of the streets and start becoming participants in the local pulse. I even found a way for us to {{5}} for our very first outing, so there is absolutely no risk in just giving it a try. Let me know what you think before the early deadline passes.
